name: Shop of Things
source:
On a gloomy afternoon, a sudden burst of rain sends you under a shop's roof.

But was it just bad weather, or did someone (or some...thing) want you under this very roof in this very moment?

Find out, by stepping into the Shop of Things!

[From [url=https://lazertoadgames.itch.io/shop-of-things]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个阴沉的下午，突如其来的大雨，让你躲到一家商店的屋檐下。

可这真的只是天气不好吗？还是有人——或者某种…东西——希望你在此时此刻，恰好来到这片屋檐下？

走进“万物商店”，寻找答案吧！

[摘自[url=https://lazertoadgames.itch.io/shop-of-things]Itch.io[/url]]
